main_text.l: tivum á genitivo singulari, os verso in εαη,ut ἥρως heros, ἥρως, ἡρώεσι:σῶμα corpus, σώματος, σωμάτεσι : γυνὴ mulier, γυ- ναικὸς, γυναικέσι.
Æolii vero dativos plurales hic parisyllabice
formant in οις, ut ὁ γέρων senex,
γέροντος, γερόντοις: quod Latini videntur imitati in
syllabus á nominativo parisyllabo, ut ὁ ἀνδραπόδων,
mancipium, τοῖς ἀνδραπό- δεσι. Sic faciunt

page.notes: Greek forms are transcribed as best legible; the scan is faded and some accents and breathings are uncertain. The signature mark at the foot reads "f" and "ij" (printed as "ij" with a superscript form).
